config.name: floorName
config.label: Floor Name
config.description: The name of the floor this computer is on.

config.name: floorNumber
config.label: Floor Number
config.description: The number of the floor this computer is on.

config.name: role
config.label: Role
config.description: Should this computer be able to call to multiple levels, or just its own level?

config.name: channel
config.label: Channel
config.description: The channel all other computers controlling this elevator should communicate on.

config.name: isHost
config.label: Is Host
config.description: Determines if this computer should act as the elevator's host. Only one computer per elevator should be host.

config.name: destinationRedstoneOutputSide
config.label: Destination Redstone Output Side
config.description: The side of the computer that should be powered when this floor is the destination.

config.name: directionRedstoneOutputSide
config.label: Direction Redstone Output Side
config.description: The side of the computer that should be powered when the elevator is moving up.

config.name: movingRedstoneOutputSide
config.label: Moving Redstone Output Side
config.description: The side of the computer that should be powered when the elevator is moving.
